# Paper

> Paper is an NSSA-certified, ESSA Level III high-impact tutoring platform delivering personalized K-12 student support with Stanford-validated outcomes.

Paper provides comprehensive educational support through its GROW tutoring program, teacher tools with Google Classroom integration, and a dedicated tutor workforce. The platform serves school districts across the US and Canada with curriculum-aligned instruction in ELA, math, and other core subjects.

## Core Platform & Products

- [GROW | High-Impact Tutoring](https://paper.co/grow): Outcome-focused small-group tutoring with curriculum alignment and Stanford-validated impact
- [Platform Overview](https://paper.co/platform-overview): Paper's integrated platform features: Live Help, Review Center, Missions, and Reading tools
- [Educational Support System](https://paper.co/solutions): Comprehensive K-12 personalized learning and tutoring support system for every student
- [GROW CA | California Schools](https://paper.co/grow-ca): CAASPP and CCSS-aligned tutoring solution for California school districts
- [GROW TX | Texas Schools](https://paper.co/grow-tx): STAAR and TEKS-aligned tutoring for Texas schools

## Teacher Support & Tools

- [Teacher Tools](https://paper.co/teacher-tools): Empower teachers with Google Classroom integration and assignment feedback capabilities
- [Teacher Assignment Tools](https://paper.co/teacher-assign): Learning gap support with Google Classroom integration for accelerating student growth
- [24/7 Teaching Assistance](https://paper.co/teachers): 24/7 educational support system with teacher insights dashboard and real-time support

## Tutor Network & Team

- [High Impact Tutors](https://paper.co/tutors): Paper's dedicated tutor workforce model providing consistent, classroom-aligned instruction

## Research & Impact

- [Paper's Impact on Student Outcomes](https://paper.co/impact): Research-backed evidence of tutoring effectiveness with Stanford validation and ESSA Level III certification

- [High Impact Tutoring FAQ Guide](https://pages.paper.co/high-impact-tutoring-faq-guide): FAQ guide on high-impact tutoring implementation and instructional continuity best practices
